name: Power Math
description: An offline scientific calculator for Android with exact fractions, equation and inequality solving (including chained comparisons), calculus, graphing, matrices, unit conversion and saved variables.
features: Exact fractions, roots and multiples of pi
Equations, inequalities and chained comparisons such as 4 < 2 + x < 6
Linear systems, expand, simplify and factor
Matrices, unit conversion, primes and number bases
Unit circle, geometric shapes, charts, sequences and algebraic identities
Home page, accent colours, animations and many settings
Fully offline, no ads, no tracking
